description:
[Deterministic corporate ESG carbon accounting. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Calculates official Scope 1 direct emissions and Scope 2 indirect emissions (Location-based & Market-based tCO2e) and standard European VSME / ESRS governance and workforce indicators using ISPRA, DEFRA, and EEA official emission factors.
Usage: Use this tool for corporate carbon accounting and CSRD sustainability reporting. For product-level carbon border tariff liabilities on imported raw materials, use 'cbam_embedded_emissions' instead.
Returns: JSON object with { scope1_tCO2e: number, scope2_location_tCO2e: number, scope2_market_tCO2e: number, totalEmissions_tCO2e: number, esrsMetrics: { genderPayGap: number, femaleManagerRatio: number, accidentFrequencyRate: number } }.

companyMetrics.description: Workforce and governance social indicators for ESRS S1 / G1 disclosures

workplaceAccidents.description: Number of workplace accidents in year

scope1.description: Direct Scope 1 fuel and refrigerant consumption

naturalGasSmc.description: Heating natural gas in standard cubic meters (Smc)

renewableSharePercent.description: Share covered by Guarantees of Origin (0-100%)

name: csrd_esg_calculator
title: CSRD ESG Scope 1 & 2 Emissions Calculator
